brief: Enough is a number. Why setting your enough number changes everything about how you build, price, and choose what to ignore.

slots.headline: The Exact Number That Changes How You Build and Price

slots.title: Define Your Enough
slots.body: Enough is not a mood. It is a specific annual number covering your baseline, margin, and growth. Write it down before you price anything. This clarity becomes the filter for every decision.

slots.title: Build With Boundaries
slots.body: When you know your number, features become choices, not obligations. You stop building for everyone and start solving for profit. Constraints create better products.

slots.title: Price For Freedom
slots.body: Your enough number reveals the minimum viable price for every offer. Below it, you trade time for stress. Above it, you buy back your life.

slots.title: Choose What To Ignore
slots.body: Every opportunity beyond your number is a distraction in disguise. Ignoring it is not laziness; it is strategy. Saying no protects your margin.

slots.title: Profit Is The Point
slots.body: Revenue without an enough target is just vanity. Profit becomes predictable when your pricing is anchored to a real number. Stop guessing. Start keeping.

slots.title: Sustain Your Energy
slots.body: Burnout follows ambition without a finish line. Your enough number is that finish line. Cross it, rest, and repeat on your own terms.

slots.headline: Anchor Your Pricing To Freedom
slots.body: Stop guessing what success looks like. Define your enough number and build a business that finally respects your time.
